gloss: ridge line; the line of a ridge

definitions.gloss: ridge line; the crest line of a ridge
definitions.explanation: The continuous high line of a mountain ridge, where the slopes on either side meet. {筋|すじ} adds the sense of a line or course running along the ridge.

examples.japanese: {尾根筋|おねすじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
⟦{登山道|とざんどう}→登山道：19132_tozandou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{尾根筋|おねすじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{沿|そ}って→沿う：13279_sou⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: The trail runs along the ridge line.

examples.japanese: {尾根筋|おねすじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}く→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧、⟦{両側|りょうがわ}→両側：28877_ryougawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{谷|たに}→谷：02223_tani⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: When we reached the ridge line, the wind was strong and we could see the valleys on both sides.

notes:
The crest line of a mountain ridge. Common in hiking and mapping contexts, where trails and boundaries often follow it.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {尾根筋|おねすじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧: to walk along the ridge
- {尾根筋|おねすじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{沿|そ}う→沿う：13279_sou⟧: to follow the ridge line

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{尾根|おね}→尾根：19839_one⟧: ridge — the ridge itself, without the "line/course" nuance of ⟦{筋|すじ}→筋：03366_suji⟧
